messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — debugging a customer bug where SDKs return different shapes for rate limits and auth failures; retries and telemetry are inconsistent.
raj: Yikes. Which SDKs and what are the inconsistencies?
maria: Node: Error with message "429 Too Many Requests" and sometimes headers. Python: RateLimitError with retry_after float. Go: status code + raw body string. No stable field names.
emma: Any customer impact yet?
maria: Yes — onboarding sample app hit 429s and our client-side retry logic was only checking the python attribute, so Node never retried.
jordan: We should define a minimal typed error contract across SDKs and a stable error payload (fields + types).
oliver: Agree. Proposal (minimal): every SDK surfaces an error object with these top-level fields: type, status, code, message, retry_after (seconds or null), request_id, details.
maria: Key fields: type + code + retry_after + request_id.
raj: Note language idioms: Go returns typed errors (structs) vs exceptions in Python/JS. For Go, return a concrete Error struct implementing error.
emma: For JS/TS: extend Error with properties: type, status, code, retryAfter, requestId, details.
jordan: Also need a clear status-code -> type mapping. Draft mapping: 400->InvalidRequest, 401->AuthError, 403->Forbidden, 404->NotFound, 409->Conflict, 429->RateLimitError, 408/502/503/504->TransientServerError, other 5xx->ServerError.
oliver: Require parsing Retry-After header per RFC (seconds or HTTP-date). SDKs should populate retry_after as float seconds.
maria: Also include boolean retryable? I prefer explicit boolean to simplify client logic.
raj: boolean + recommended policies: rate limits -> retryable=true, 5xx -> retryable=true with exponential backoff, auth -> retryable=false.
emma: Migration: don't break users. Feature-flag rollout: emit new properties while keeping existing message string. Add changelog migration notes.
jordan: Tests: parity tests in CI across SDKs — given an HTTP response, assert error.type/code/status/retry_after/retryable match expected.
oliver: Security: details may contain user data. Default to redacted details; provide raw payload only when debug flag enabled. PII review required.
sre-bot: reminder: include request_id consistently so ops can tie client errors to server logs. Also sample rate-limited traces help debugging.
raj: SDK implementers — please add structured error type, parse Retry-After robustly, and include request_id.
emma: Sample snippets for product docs and onboarding apps (JS + Python) to show retry pattern.

JS example:
```js
try {
  await client.generate(...)
} catch (err) {
  if (err.type === 'RateLimitError' && err.retry_after) {
    await sleep(err.retry_after * 1000)
    return retry()
  }
  throw err
}
```

Python example:
```py
try:
    client.generate(...)
except RateLimitError as e:
    time.sleep(e.retry_after)
    retry()
```

maria: Action items:
1) jordan: draft RFC + status-code mapping table (today)
2) SDK leads: implement typed error shape behind feature flag + parity tests (2 weeks)
3) DevEx (maria): example snippets + migration guide
4) Security (oliver): PII review for details field

jordan: I'll own RFC. Reviewers: maria, raj, oliver, emma, security. Will post link here when ready.
devx-bot: Added card: "Unified SDK error contract RFC" assigned to jordan, due 2026-03-01.
maria: Leaving thread open for quick follow-ups. :eyes:
